title.narrative: Renewable Energy Generation and Access Increase Project

description.narrative: The development objective is (i) to scale up renewable energy generation, (ii) increase electricity access in targeted outer islands, and (iii) enhance resilience of the power sector.

The development objective of the Accelerating Sustainable Energy Transition Program for East Asia and Pacific is to help accelerate renewable energy scale up in the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) countries, including through regional power trade. The project comprises of three components. The first component is regional renewable energy policy support and climate financing; the second component is regional power trade; and the third component is knowledge sharing, consultations, and capacity building.
